name: SuperNotch
author: Andrés Villagrán <andres@villagranquiroz.cl>
description: Anclave-style animated notch for Omarchy/Hyprland: a tiny center pill that blooms into a dark, rounded, heavily-animated command center — music (MPRIS), tasks, clipboard, pomodoro, shelf, calendar and activity. No account, no server, all local.

barWidget.description: Animated notch command center (click the center pill or SUPER+SHIFT+N).
